title: 20 Minutes of Grind
hook: Twenty minutes of drilling. Zero invoice.

scenes.text: Right now, while I’m talking, Nemotron 3 Ultra has been drilling for twenty minutes. Free.
It hit a Playwright browser install, a locked cache, a permissions wall. It tried another path. And another. Nobody paid for the retries.
On a paid model that’s a very patient meter running. Here it’s just a progress bar and a kettle.
